name: Reading Tap Guard
changes: When the settings refuse a Pro choice, for example in Double tap interval, the keyboard focus now stays on that setting.
tip: Open Settings, Reading Tap Guard, and pick what a double tap does in Reading view. The edit button and the Toggle reading view command always work.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Reading Tap Guard is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
